visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a clean medical clinic. A male doctor, wearing a grey medical uniform with 'S.P. Liu M.D.' embroidered on it, stands next to a white BBL machine. He holds the handpiece of the device. The background shows professional medical lighting and office decor. (2) Close-up shots follow, focusing on the equipment's details. A digital screen displays parameters like Fluence and Temperature. A drawer opens to reveal various colored light filters labeled 515, 800ST, 420, and 560. The lighting remains bright and sterile. (3) The doctor performs the treatment on a patient lying down. The patient's eyes are covered with metallic protective goggles. The handpiece emits rhythmic flashes of yellow and red light as it glides over the patient's face. The doctor wears gloves and moves the device with precision across the cheeks and chin. (4) The video transitions to a static white background featuring the DRX clinic logo. Contact information including a LINE handle, phone number, and two physical addresses in New Taipei City and Taipei City are displayed clearly in the center.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional tool for DRX Dermatology Clinic, showcasing the BBL Hero skin treatment machine. It highlights technical aspects like interchangeable filters and emphasizes the non-invasive nature of the treatment to attract clients seeking skin rejuvenation.
